deliverables.title: Practice Exercises
deliverables.notes: Graded for completion, not accuracy. Online with flexible deadlines. Weekly cadence throughout the term.
deliverables.ambiguity_reason: Described as weekly with flexible deadlines; no specific day or individual due dates stated. Weight is the series total.

deliverables.title: Midterm Examination
deliverables.notes: Online with Proctortrack. Asynchronous — completed at any time during a designated time window. Designated assessment requiring supporting documentation for academic consideration. Precise date posted on course BrightSpace.
deliverables.ambiguity_reason: Syllabus states 'usually scheduled during the seventh week of classes' with exact date posted on BrightSpace; no specific calendar date provided.

deliverables.title: Final Examination
deliverables.notes: Online with Proctortrack. Synchronous — everyone completes it at the scheduled time. Scheduled by the Office of the Registrar (OOR) during the final exam period.
deliverables.ambiguity_reason: No specific date given; scheduled by the Office of the Registrar during the final examination period, which falls after semester_end.
